newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Cricket-Cox nears hundred for Tasmania against Pakistan.
newsitem.headline: Cricket-Cox nears hundred for Tasmania against Pakistan.

text.p: Tasmania opening batsman Jamie Cox was close to a century as Tasmania reached 191 for two at lunch on the second day of their four-day match against Pakistan at Bellerive Oval on Friday.
Cox was on 94 not out at the break, with test batsman Ricky Ponting unbeaten on 24 as Tasmania made light work of their chase to better Pakistan's first innings total of 299.
Tasmania resumed on 73 for one with Cox on 39 and the opener went on to make a valuable partnership of 90 with nightwatchman Daniel Marsh.
Marsh was stumped by Moin Khan for 28 from the bowling of Mushtaq Ahmed.
